episodes.title: இந்தப் படம் எது?
episodes.summary: A strict new headmistress transforms a neglected village government school against lazy teachers, a private school owner and politicians; the nickname the slackers give her is the film's title.
episodes.cliffhanger: Viewers must guess the film from the nickname clue.
